metadata.description: A per-task harness for Claude Code: fail-closed hooks, a hash-chained run ledger, and a gate that signs what was actually checked.

plugins.name: dynamic-harness
plugins.description: Sizes each request (quick answer, checked task, careful task), freezes the work list, runs registered checks in a sandbox, and lets a task end as done only on an HMAC-signed gate receipt. Built on loop-contract.
